integrity: An exact mathematical proof is presented and a finite diagnostic script is supplied. Priority relative to unindexed nonconvex rigidity literature remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Requires a simple CCW boundary with a marked origin in its strict kernel and comparison within the same star-shaped class; does not assert generic or unconstrained graph embedding rigidity; the convex subcase is previously known.
title: Exact Gram completion for star-shaped polygonal cycles
